summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist per the spec. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (public loader plus private _resolve_path helper, stdlib only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Beyond the spec, the loader also raises ValueError when the top-level JSON is not an object or the key's value is not a list. Tests were not run and black/flake8 were not run, per instructions; line lengths were checked by measurement (none over 120) and wrapping by reading. Nothing committed.
